column5: Trade > Dev tokens 1440. ALL FOUR recorded gaps closed and re-measured on the rendered DOM at vw=1440. (1) Row pitch was `h-[46px] md:h-[52px]` = 52; now `h-[44px]`, measured 44 == frame 44 (y=797/841/885/929). (2) Panel TAB row was text-xs/[16px] = 12 at every width; TabRow now carries `lg:text-sm/[20px] lg:tracking-[-0.56px]`, measured 14px/20px at 1440 and still 12px/16px at 768/375 (which 13006:260059 recorded as a match). -0.48px IS -0.04em at 12px and -0.56px the same -0.04em at 14px, so the letterfit is unchanged. (3) Token-info rail badges were skai-label-2 = 12; TokenInfoPanel's tiles now use TILE_TYPE = skai-label-3 lg:text-[11px] lg:leading-[14px], measured 11px at 1440. (4) Headers 12 and body 14 already matched and still do. Trench table ramp CLOSED this lane and RE-MEASURED on the running dev server at 375/768/1440: body cells now `TRENCH_ROW_TYPE` = skai-para-3 lg:text-sm lg:leading-5, computing 12px/16 below 1024 and 14px/20 at and above it (byte-identical to the old skai-para-2 on desktop: 14px/20px Manrope, -0.56px).

Tables - Dev tokens 768. All three recorded gaps closed, re-measured on the rendered DOM at vw=768. (1) Track was min-w-[920px] against the frame's ~830 (rightmost column ends x=777): DEVTOKENS_GRID_COLS floors retuned to 158/64/48 + 6x72 and DEVTOKENS_MIN_TRACK to min-w-[830px] - measured track 830px, columns 158 64 48 72 72 72 72 72 72. Only the FLOORS moved; the six value columns are still 1fr, so the desktop board is unchanged. (2) Row pitch 52 -> 44, measured 44. (3) Body 14 -> 12, measured 12px/16. Column set (9 headers) already matched.

Tables - Dev tokens 375. The STRUCTURAL gap is closed: the frame drops to five columns (Token / Migrated / Mkt. Cap. / 1H volume / Bal.) on a ~430px track and the panel shipped all nine on min-w-[920px]. DevTokensPanel now branches on a real media query at md (not `hidden md:*` - a CSS-hidden second table would put every dev token in the DOM twice) into DEVTOKENS_COMPACT_GRID_COLS + min-w-[430px]; measured track 430px, columns 88 52 70 70 70. Header and cells select the SAME five indices (DEVTOKENS_COMPACT_COLUMNS) so they cannot drift. Pitch 44 measured == frame 44. Body 12 measured == frame 12. Covered by a new test that fails if either width's column set changes.

Tables - Holders 375. The one recorded FAIL (body 12 in the frame, skai-para-2 = 14 in code) is closed - measured 12px/16 at vw=375. The track also now matches: HOLDERS_MIN_TRACK 560 -> 530, which is the frame's own ~530 (rightmost column ends x=504); measured track 530px, columns 48 160 77 77 88. min-w is a FLOOR, so a wide cell still grows the track rather than overflowing it. Row pitch 46 already matched and is unchanged at 375 (`h-[46px] md:h-[44px]`, measured 46 at 375 / 44 at 768). Column set (5) already matched.

Tables - Top holders 375. Same close as 13006:299940 and deliberately byte-identical to it: body 14 -> 12 (measured 12px/16), track 560 -> 530 (measured 530px), row height 52 -> `h-[46px] md:h-[44px]` (measured 46 at 375). The two panels render ONE grid (HOLDERS_GRID_COLS) so two copies of one table must not disagree about their own width or row height.

Token info 768. Both recorded gaps closed, re-measured at vw=768. (1) Every tile VALUE and LABEL was skai-label-2 = 12 against the frame's 10 - now TILE_TYPE = skai-label-3 lg:text-[11px] lg:leading-[14px], measured 10px/12 Mulish at 768 and 375, 11px/14 at 1440 (which is what 13006:230793 measures). (2) The CA:/DA: VALUE was 12 against the frame's 10 - now skai-label-3 lg:text-xs lg:leading-4, measured 10px at 768/375. Its CAPTION stays skai-label-2 = 12, which already matched. The desktop step for the address value deliberately restores today's 12px rather than the tiles' 11px: no 1440 measurement was taken of that row specifically. 4-column grid (x=117/297/470/634) and the 44px tile box already matched and are untouched.

Token info 375. Same TILE_TYPE close as 13006:271691 - tile value and label measured 10px/12 Mulish at vw=375 against the frame's 10 (30 of this frame's 61 texts). 3-column grid (x=63/187/304) already matched and is untouched.

Trackers > Wallets - empty 375. The recorded gap was the ramp and nothing else (this frame draws no rows, so there is no row pitch to compare). All four ramps now move with the breakpoint and were re-measured on the rendered DOM at 375/768/1440: HEADER_CELL 12/12/12 (the `lg:text-sm` step is GONE - it made the header 14 at exactly the width this board draws at 12); ROW_TIME 12/12/14; ROW_VALUE 12/14/16; ROW_SUBVALUE 10/10/11. Desktop pixels are unchanged for the three row constants.
Trackers > Wallets - empty 768. Same close as 13006:319384; measured at vw=768 header 12, cell 12, value 14, sub 10.

Trackers > X accounts - empty 375. Same close as 13006:319384. XAccountsPanel's own row type (tabs text-sm = 14, handles text-xs = 12) already matched 13006:321618 / 13006:346515 and is untouched; the shared ActivityView constants are what moved.
Trackers > X accounts - empty 768. Same close as 13006:321483; measured at vw=768.

Tables - Transactions 768. STRUCTURAL MISMATCH RESOLVED: the panel no longer ships the six-column table on a min-w-[680px] scroller at this width. Below lg it now renders a two-row CARD per record - Time / Type / Mkt. Cap. / Amount, then Total USD / Trader - with all six captions REDRAWN inside every record, exactly as `13006:269108` draws them. Built on the PositionsPanel pattern: one exported `toTransactionView()` produces every display string and the table and the card only decide where it sits, so a change to the unknown-marker or side-colour rule cannot land in one copy and miss the other. Gated on a real media query, not `hidden lg:*`. Cells measured 12px/16 at vw=768 == frame 12. RESIDUAL, measured on the rendered DOM: record pitch 109 against the frame's 118. The 9px is two unbuilt glyph clusters - the Type cell is a `labels/tag` pill 18px tall in the frame (13006:269115) where code draws coloured text 16px tall, and the Trader value sits in a 24px control cluster (copy + action icons + a count tag, 13006:269140) where code draws a single 16px line. Neither is invented here: the tag's fill was not measured and the trader row's icons have no wired action. Second residual: the list inset is px-4 = 16 against the frame's 12 - the same approximation PositionsPanel's compact list already carries, left consistent rather than split. ★ A REAL BUG WAS FOUND AND FIXED WHILE MEASURING: `container py-3` + `card first:pt-0 last:pb-0` (copied from PositionsPanel) produces a NON-UNIFORM pitch - measured 96px for the first gap and 109px for every later one, against a frame that is 118 all the way down. The container now carries no vertical padding and every record its own py-3, measured uniform. PositionsPanel still has the original pairing - see the lane report.
Tables - Transactions 768, second node (423 nodes / 84 texts vs 13006:268978's 397/79). Same card fix and the same two residuals - see 13006:268978.

Tables - Transactions 375. Same card fix as 13006:268978: captions redrawn per record, cells measured 12px/16 at vw=375, and the min-w-[680px] scroller no longer renders at this width at all. RESIDUAL: record pitch 109 against the frame's 116 - same two unbuilt clusters (Type tag pill, trader control row). Loading and empty states use a local two-column track rather than TX_GRID_COLS, whose min-content floor (680px) would have escaped a 343px content column to the app shell's <main> and dragged the whole terminal sideways.
Tables - Transactions 375, second node (422 nodes / 77 texts vs 13006:299321's 396/72). Same card fix and the same residual - see 13006:299321.

Trade > Transactions 1440. Two of the three recorded gaps closed and re-measured at vw=1440: row pitch was `md:h-[52px]`, now `h-[44px]` (the table is >=lg only, so it needs no ramp), measured 44 == frame 44 (y=797/841/885/929); panel tab row was 12 everywhere, now measured 14px/20px at 1440. Headers 12 and body 14 already matched. RESIDUAL: the frame draws Buy/Sell as an 11px CHIP and code draws 14px coloured text. Not built - the chip's fill and radius were not measured, and inventing a tint for the buy/sell indicator is a design decision, not a parity fix.

Tables - Holders 768. Type and geometry closed: body 14 -> 12 (measured 12px/16 at vw=768), row height `md:h-[52px]` -> `md:h-[44px]` (measured 44), track 560 -> 530 (measured 530px). STILL PARTIAL, and NOT for want of effort: the frame's nine columns include SOL balance (last), Bought (avg. buy), Sold (avg. sell), uPnL and Funding, which need a per-wallet TRANSACTION index (Helius / Bitquery class) that nobody runs - the same blocker status.trade-2.trench.tsv row 37 records for the 1440 twin. VERIFIED before building: `useTokenHolders` resolves balance and % supply only, from `solana-token-holders` (Alchemy -> public RPC) and `evm-token-holders` (Etherscan V2); neither payload carries a per-wallet trade history. Five real columns beat nine columns four of which would be fabricated.

Tables - Top holders 768. Same close and the same blocker as 13006:269297 - body 12 (measured), row height 44 (measured), track 530 (measured); the four per-wallet trade columns remain unsourced. The Top traders / Top holders label divergence stands and is still documented in trade/content.ts.

Trackers > Wallet manager 1440. The recorded HEADER gap is closed: HEADER_CELL was `text-xs lg:text-sm`, i.e. 14 at 1440 where this frame draws 12; the lg step is removed and the header measures 12px/16 at all three widths. Cell 14 / balance 16 / sub 11 still measure exactly that at 1440 - the new ramps were written so desktop pixels do not move. STILL PARTIAL on a gap the wave-3 pass recorded but did not compare to code: the frame's row pitch is 48 (y=261/309/357) and the rendered row measures 61 at 768 and above. These rows have no fixed height - the pitch is `py-3` plus the tallest cell, which is the 16px value over its 14px sub-line - so closing it means retuning padding on the Whales screen, which other lanes are editing. Raised, not taken.

Trackers > Live trades 1440. Header closed (12 measured at 1440, was 14). STILL PARTIAL on a CONTRADICTION INSIDE ONE BOARD, not on effort: this frame draws its cells at 12 at 1440 while 13006:179860 (Wallet manager, same width) draws them at 14, and both tables render from the SAME `ROW_TIME` constant. The ramp follows the Wallet-manager number (12/12/14), so Live trades is 14 at 1440 where its own frame says 12. Splitting the constant per table is a deliberate divergence between two tables that were built as one component - escalated rather than guessed. Row pitch also outstanding: frame 40, rendered 45 at 768 / 49 at lg.
Trackers > Live trades 1440, second node (731 nodes / 178 texts vs 13006:180340's 846/206). Same header close, same 12-vs-14 cell contradiction, same outstanding pitch - see 13006:180340.
